visitor.name: Prof. Joyce Y. Chai
visitor.bio: Professor of CSE at University of Michigan; directs the SLED Lab advancing situated dialogue, multimodal grounding, and human-robot collaboration.

target.name: Natnael Bekele
target.bio: Software engineer building agentic investment systems; aspiring AI safety researcher studying latent intentions, interpretability, and agent reliability; ex-A2SV Head of Education.

nodes.name: Dr. Martin Ma
nodes.bio: PhD candidate at UMich advised by Prof. Joyce Chai. Researches multimodal agents and co-organized the 1st Workshop on Bidirectional Human-AI Alignment (ICLR 2025).

nodes.name: Dr. Jed Yang
nodes.bio: PhD from UMich advised by Prof. Joyce Chai. Created LLM-Grounder for 3D language grounding; ex-Meta AI software engineer.

nodes.name: Dan Hendrycks
nodes.bio: Executive Director of the Center for AI Safety (CAIS); advisor to xAI and Scale AI. Created the MMLU benchmark and GELU activations.

nodes.name: Emre Varol
nodes.bio: Founder of Africa to Silicon Valley (A2SV); ex-Google SWE. Mentored and helped place 100+ African engineers into top tech companies.

edges.context: You advised Dr. Ma's PhD on Bidirectional Human-AI Alignment
You advised Dr. Yang's PhD on LLM-Grounder
Both actively advance AI Alignment and Safety research
Both are ex-Big Tech SWEs (Meta, Google) building AI startups
Natnael's Dormant Defection research builds on CAIS frameworks
Emre founded A2SV where Natnael was Head of Education

shared_bullets: Your lab's recent work on evaluating safety-conscious planning of MLLMs (ACL 2026) strongly resonates with my focus on hidden intentions in agentic systems.
We share an interest in Human-AI Alignment; your co-organization of the 1st Workshop on Bidirectional Human-AI Alignment (ICLR 2025) aligns perfectly with my PhD goals.
We are both passionate about evaluating and building reliable, embodied AI agents that safely act on physical and situational contexts.
